question: Should OpenClaw adopt this permanent core AI-safety taxonomy, plugin capability, and durable operator-history surface, or should the observability integrations remain outside core until a narrower approved contract exists?
rationale: The PR adds a new public plugin API, manifest permission, Gateway protocol methods, and an operator audit surface; the repository policy treats those as compatibility- and product-sensitive and the linked feature request has not yet received maintainer sponsorship.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded core contract
options.body: Approve a narrowly specified host-owned taxonomy and durable-record design, then require the concrete security, manifest-forwarding, session, and proof fixes before merge.

options.title: Keep optional integrations outside core
options.body: Retain generic diagnostics seams in core and route exporters, dashboards, and policy-specific collection to plugins until a demonstrated missing core API is identified.

options.title: Pause this proposal
options.body: Do not adopt the new public surfaces now; preserve the open feature discussion for a future maintainer-sponsored design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded core contract
recommendation.body: Approve a narrowly specified host-owned taxonomy and durable-record design, then require the concrete security, manifest-forwarding, session, and proof fixes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: No current-main owner for this unmerged, cross-cutting feature is established by the available history.
